snippet.title: Rewindead - Announcement Trailer (Old Version)
snippet.description:
Rewindead is a single-player, third-person shooter about contract killing in time loops. Assassinate your target, rewind time, then eliminate your past selves before they complete the hit.
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4609750/Rewindead_Demo/
